rana: Heads-up: spike of strict-validate rejects for fncall in na-central. Reject rate jumped from ~0.15% -> 0.9% last 20m. Sample from validator:
```
{
  "error": "missing_required",
  "path": "request.payload.items",
  "expected": "array",
  "got": "null"
}
```
Any idea if it's a client regression or validator strictness? cc @kai @sophia

kai: Noticed a few customer SDKs rolled last week. Could be a change in how they encode empty lists. But we should also discuss a "mediation" stage: try light coercions (null->[], string->[string]) before rejecting. It would reduce customer-facing errors and keep routing stable.

sophia: Mediation sounds neat, but telemetry + billing implications are real. If we coerce and pass through, quotas and model-variant routing must still attribute to original route. Otherwise ops + accounting get wrong counters. Also we need strong audit events showing original+mediation decisions.

derek: Two mediation modes I like: AUTO_COERCE (apply heuristics & continue) and SUGGEST_FIX (reject but return structured suggestion and a small warning tag for console). SUGGEST_FIX keeps behavior safe while surfacing fixes. AUTO_COERCE is higher risk but better UX.

policy-bot: Canary metadata: feature=fncall-mediation, region=na-central, rollout_pct=5, mode=OFF

ops-oncall: If we flip AUTO_COERCE in canary, alerting must catch silent changes. Add metric fncall.mediation.applied and alert if mediation_applied_rate > 0.4% OR mediation_failures > 50/min. Page eng-oncall.

kai: Implementation idea: mediation runs after parsing but before routing. It produces event fields: mediation_applied=true|false, mediation_kind=COERCE|SUGGEST, orig_error, route_id, account_id. Important: include validator_version and mediation_version. Sampling for full payloads at 2% for mediated requests.

sophia: Agree on event fields. I'll add a schema for mediation events and ensure route_id/account_id are captured even when validation happens early. Also standardize mediation reasons into enum: NULL_COERCE, WRAP_IN_ARRAY, STRING_TO_ARRAY, TYPE_PROMOTION, OTHER.

rana: Console UX: for SUGGEST_FIX show the suggestion back to the customer with a one-click "apply suggestion" for sandboxed replay. For AUTO_COERCE, show a soft warning banner and a per-account toggle in the console: "Allow input mediation (experimental)" default OFF.

derek: For rollout plan: 1) enable SUGGEST_FIX for 5% canary in na-central, 2) add mediation events & telemetry, 3) after 48h review, consider AUTO_COERCE at 1% with strict observability. If AUTO_COERCE expands, keep quota attribution to original route via mediation_override_route flag.

policy-bot: Update: SUGGEST_FIX enabled in na-central canary (rollout_pct=5). Change logged by deploy-user at 2024-07-02T11:05:12Z

kai: I'll open INF-5001 to track mediation product + infra work and attach dashboard mock: "fncall: rejects vs mediation_applied by account" + top mediation reasons.

sophia: PR incoming to telemetry repo to add mediation event spec and alerting rules (PR: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-401). Will include retention notes and sampling knobs.

ops-oncall: Reminder: ensure playbook has rollback steps in case mediation causes downstream model-behavior regressions. We saw weird outputs when we coerced earlier in a different experiment.

derek: Noted. I'll add rollback and quick-toggle to console rollout feed and document potential fail modes. Also adding unit tests to validator for mediation safety.

rana: OK let's run SUGGEST_FIX canary and monitor. Keep communication in INF-5001 and telemetry PR comments. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
